$comment: Social platform limits that scripts enforce and prose quotes. One value per fact, each with where it was read. Scripts read it through _common.platform_spec(); prose points here instead of restating a number, and tests/test_platform_specs.py fails when a doc states one of these facts with another number, and 30 days before any review_by. A field not re-read this round has verified_on null and an early review_by, so the check sends someone back to the vendor page. A REPORTED note means the vendor page could not be read and the value rests on the quoted statement.
schema: each field: value, source_url, source_date (the source's own date, null when undated), verified_on (when this value was last checked against the source, null if not this round), review_by, note

caption_display_chars.note: Characters shown before 'more' on a feed post. Carried from 3.39.1.

hashtags_cap.note: REPORTED: Instagram's @creators account, 2025-12-18: 'Starting today, Instagram will allow up to 5 hashtags in a reel or post' (quoted by Social Media Today and Betanews, 2025-12-19). help.instagram.com/351460621611097 still shows the old 30.

hashtags_advised.note: Practice within the cap: one broad, specific and niche tags.

reel_max_seconds.note: REPORTED: reels can be recorded and edited up to 20 minutes (help page quoted by the search index; it is JavaScript-only from here).

reel_recommended_max_seconds.note: REPORTED: reels over 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences.

post_display_chars.note: Characters shown before 'See more'. Carried from 3.39.1.

reel_max_seconds.note: Meta newsroom post of 2025-06-17. No length limit: 'all videos on Facebook will be shared as reels ... Reels on Facebook will also not have any length or format restrictions' (updated 2025-07-14; completion end of September 2025 is REPORTED).

topic_tags_cap.note: Threads API docs: 'Only one topic tag is allowed per post.' Topic tags render without the #.

links_cap.note: Threads changelog, 2025-12-22: five links per post.

post_display_chars.note: About 140 on mobile, 210 on desktop before 'see more'. Carried from 3.39.1.

post_chars.note: Standard accounts; X Premium allows longer posts. Carried from 3.39.1.

hashtags_advised.note: Practice, not a platform cap; hashtags spend the character budget.

links_advised.note: Practice. A link counts as 23 characters.

caption_chars.note: Sources disagree (2,200 vs 4,000) and no primary page was readable on 2026-10-27; 2,200 fits either until an in-app check settles it. Owner to check in the app.

video_max_seconds.note: In-app uploads up to 10 minutes. Carried from 3.39.1.

hashtags_advised.note: Practice; discovery runs on custom feeds and search.

video_max_seconds.note: Shorts up to 3 minutes. Since 2025-03-31 a Short's view counts when it starts to play or replay; the old metric is 'engaged views'.
